convention: tay_trai/tay_phai, chan_trai/chan_phai theo phia nhan vat (nhan vat nhin ra man hinh). z: so thap = ve sau (sau), so cao = ve truoc. pivot: [x,y] theo toa do canvas goc.

parts.name: chan_trai
parts.note: Chan trai NV (phai anh), giay. Pivot hong. Di lai: xoay quanh hong.

parts.name: chan_phai
parts.note: Chan phai NV (trai anh), giay. Pivot hong. Di lai: xoay quanh hong.

parts.name: than
parts.note: Ao xam tu vai den chan. Pivot giua nguc. Cui chao: xoay nhe.

parts.name: phu_kien_gay
parts.note: Gay tre + ho lo treo. Pivot diem tay nam. Lac nhe khi di.

parts.name: phu_kien_quat
parts.note: Quat giay ve son thuy. Pivot diem tay cam. QUAT: xoay/mo quat quanh diem cam dong bo tay_phai.

parts.name: tay_trai
parts.note: Tay trai NV (phai anh) cam gay. Pivot vai.

parts.name: tay_phai
parts.note: Tay phai NV (trai anh) cam quat. Pivot vai. Vay quat: xoay tay quanh vai, quat quay theo quanh diem cam.

parts.name: dau
parts.note: Mat + rau trang dai. Pivot co. Gat/lac dau: xoay quanh co; rau di theo dau.

parts.name: phu_kien_mu_trum
parts.note: Mu trum xam + bui toc. Pivot dinh dau. Nghieng theo dau.
